name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 17 – Am 107/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 17a. Calls for urgent financial support to ensure the timely supply of defence products through joint procurement, industrial coordination, stockpiling, access to finance for manufacturers and the expansion and modernisation of production capacities, emphasising that this funding should prioritise Member States bordering Ukraine, to enhance its protection, and Member States bordering Russia, to further deter potential threats;
